# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta is described as a flighty girl.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P6](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0006)_

## Personality

She is noted for her flightiness and heedlessness, often requiring scolding for her behavior.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P6](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0006)_

## Traits

- Flighty  <sub>[v1 c6 P6](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0006)</sub>
- Heedless  <sub>[v1 c6 P6](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0006)</sub>

## History

Charlotta is the daughter of Robert Spencer. She passed along an important message regarding the adoption of a child from an orphan asylum, but twisted the instructions, leading Mrs. Alexander Spencer to bring an orphan girl instead of the requested boy for Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert.

_Sources: [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 c6 P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 c6 P6](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0006)_

## Relationships

### Mrs. Alexander Spencer
